Table 27.7: Management of Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS)
PEEP: 6 cmH₂O Adjust FiO₂ and PEEP according to severity of respiratory distress and oxygen saturation.
Kangaroo Mother Care (intermittent skin-to-skin contact where appropriate)
If unable to feed, initiate IV fluids as per neonatal fluid guidelines
Administer if ALL of the following are present:
PEEP requirement ≥7 cmH₂O to maintain oxygen saturation ≥90%
D: Beractant 100 mg/kg (4 mL/kg) intratracheally as a single dose via endotracheal tube; may repeat every 6 hours if required to a maximum of 4 doses

blocks.text: Post-administration care: Continue CPAP after surfactant administration where appropriate and monitor oxygen saturation, respiratory effort, and need for repeat dosing.

blocks.text: Surfactant administration should only be performed at Level D facility (Regional Referral Hospital) and above by trained healthcare providers.

blocks.text: Consider mechanical ventilation if: Severe respiratory distress:
Persistent oxygen saturation <90% after second dose of surfactant
Recurrent apnoea: More than two episodes within 24 hours
Refer promptly to a higher-level facility when:
Surfactant therapy is required but unavailable
Severe prematurity/low birth weight requiring specialized care
District Hospital and above: Sick neonates and/or neonates <1.8 kg
Start IV fluids if dehydrated or in shock
For gastroschisis: provide rehydration fluids as per neonatal fluid guidelines
Insert NGT for decompression where indicated
Maintain glucose through breastfeeding, NGT feeding, or IV fluids as appropriate
